name: U.S. SEC EDGAR (company tickers, submissions, full-text search)
tier_rationale: U.S. federal regulator publishing EDGAR with a documented fair-access policy (A8 trusted); P223 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Official regulatory filings (8-K Item 1.05 material cybersecurity incidents are self-disclosed by the registrant); name-to-company matches stay POSSIBLE unless CIK or ticker match (P223 cond 5).

error_markers.regex: Request Rate Threshold Exceeded|Automated access to our sites|Undeclared Automated Tool
error_markers.reason: SEC fair-access block (HTTP 403): requests need the identifying User-Agent with the team role mailbox (setting contact_email) and at most 10 req/s; SEC blocks offenders for about 10 minutes - could not verify, never 'no filings'

company_tickers.title: SEC company_tickers.json (CIK, ticker, title) as a daily dataset matched locally

terms.quote: company_tickers.json is a daily dataset (dataset manager) matched locally, so the company name is not disclosed for that step; CIK is padded to 10 digits for submissions. US government work, public domain.

company_tickers.notes: Quote: binding council text (P223 cond 3 and 6). www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json (~800 KB, ~10,400 rows). Batch p3-G10-1.

submissions.title: SEC EDGAR submissions API (data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json): company facts and recent filings metadata

terms.quote: Output: the company's CIK/ticker and cyber-incident disclosures (form, date, company, filing URL) as INFO/LOW supplier-incident context. Filing metadata and links only, no filing bodies stored. US government work, public domain.

submissions.notes: Quote: binding council text (P223 cond 5 and 6). Research C0522: 200 with an identifying 'Org contact@email' User-Agent, 403 with a browser-like one. Batch p3-G10-1.

efts.title: SEC EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index): first page only, 8-K/8-K/A Item 1.05 and 6-K

terms.quote: Full-text search (efts.sec.gov) only for the counterparty name, first page only (<= 10 hits per entity), restricted to 8-K/8-K/A filings with Item 1.05 (material cybersecurity incident) and 6-K mentions for foreign issuers.

efts.notes: Quote: binding council text (P223 cond 4). EFTS has no grouping: parentheses become literal phrases (live 2026-11-26), so queries never carry them. Batch p3-G10-1.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-1 (P223). BINDING PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS (www.sec.gov, data.sec.gov, efts.sec.gov): user_agent 'contact' (SEC fair access: the UA carries the team role mailbox from setting contact_email; without it the provider is SKIPPED 'config'). Rate: SEC caps 10 req/s; the council asked for <= 2 req/s (P223 cond 2): min_interval 0.5 s and a quota safety margin of 0.2 (2 req/s budget).
